policy.authority: server-selected resume ID only; no guessing or automatic replacement
policy.history: original cwd/native history retained; per-run IR and fresh verification baseline
policy.persistence: metadata only; atomic mode 0600; immutable ownership
policy.concurrency: one supervisor-owned turn per native session
policy.migration: unindexed legacy selection warned; unindexed repository resume blocked
policy.missing_history: known missing or invalid history blocked before workspace creation

limits: no OpenClaw resume or session fork
no UI session navigation or frontend deployment
legacy unindexed session continuity remains unverified

loop.observation: Session IDs alone do not preserve cwd/history across runs and non-Codex providers can replace pins.
loop.hypothesis: Durable context-bound ownership and pre-publication identity validation preserve native history without guessing sessions.
loop.execute: Pin metadata before server publication; restore retained cwd and reopen host verification baseline.
loop.evaluate: Hermetic restart/follow-up/isolation/missing-history/conflicting-pin tests, race and full CI.
loop.retrospective: Keep server resume authority and per-run evidence separate from provider-native history; unknown legacy history remains explicit.
